sql = """WITH line_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity AS line_cents,
        il.Quantity AS qty
    FROM InvoiceLine AS il
    JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
      AND il.Quantity > 0
),
country_genre AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        SUM(line_cents) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(qty) AS units
    FROM line_sales
    GROUP BY country, genre_id, genre
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM country_genre
)
SELECT
    country,
    CAST(genre_id AS INTEGER) AS genre_id,
    genre,
    CAST(revenue_cents AS INTEGER) AS revenue_cents,
    CAST(units AS INTEGER) AS units,
    CAST(country_rank AS INTEGER) AS country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
"""

def run(db, count_steps=False):
    c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro',uri=True)
    allowed={'Invoice','InvoiceLine','Track','Genre'}
    def auth(action,a1,a2,dbn,trig):
        if action==sqlite3.SQLITE_READ and a1 not in allowed: return sqlite3.SQLITE_DENY
        if action in (sqlite3.SQLITE_SELECT,sqlite3.SQLITE_READ,sqlite3.SQLITE_FUNCTION): return sqlite3.SQLITE_OK
        return sqlite3.SQLITE_DENY
    c.set_authorizer(auth)
    steps=[0]
    def ph(): steps[0]+=1000; return 0
    c.set_progress_handler(ph,1000)
    cur=c.execute(sql); cols=[d[0] for d in cur.description]; rows=cur.fetchall()
    c.close(); return cols,rows,steps[0]

# independent Python reference
def ref(db,lo='2021-01-01',hi='2022-01-01'):
    c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro',uri=True)
    agg=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0]); names={}
    for country,gid,gname,up,q,d in c.execute("select i.BillingCountry,t.GenreId,g.Name,il.UnitPrice,il.Quantity,i.InvoiceDate from InvoiceLine il join Invoice i using(InvoiceId) join Track t using(TrackId) join Genre g on g.GenreId=t.GenreId"):
        if lo<=d<hi:
            a=agg[(country,gid)]; a[0]+=int(round(up*100))*q; a[1]+=q; names[gid]=gname
    by=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for (co,g),(rv,u) in agg.items(): by[co].append((-rv,g,u))
    out=[]
    for co in sorted(by):
        for k,(nrv,g,u) in enumerate(sorted(by[co])[:2],1): out.append((co,g,names[g],-nrv,u,k))
    return out
